answer: Creating N fake identities costs N full bonds plus N hardware attestations, while honest peers cross-check answers and broadcast any whisper of duplication, slashing the duplicate stake. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose answer is derived from a unique inlet of entropy, then sign it with a hardware-bound quill key. Sybils thus pay linearly more than they can ever earn. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
